diffuse_path: required, trail id, every trail should be have a unique id in game
normal_path: required/optional(decided by emissive) texture, aka basecolor
tangent_path: required/optional(decided by diffuse), for glow or bloom
full: float, in second, and duration(fade in + full + fade out) cannot be lower than 0.0334
velocity_out_range: vec4f, based on forward directio, [minX, minY, maxX, maxY]
angular_in_range: vec4f, based on forward directio, [minX, minY, maxX, maxY]
angular_out_range: vec2f, based on forward directio, in angle, [min, max]
additive_blend: vec2f, based on forward directio, in angle, [min, max]
velocity_for_forward: vec4f, based on forward direction, [minX, minY, maxX, maxY]
